attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished full-detail location key, a single landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG, 3:2 composition, edge to edge, no borders or inset panels.
Primary request: Draw ONLY the upstairs INTERIOR of the little family restaurant in reference image 1. This is Bomi's cramped streaming room in a modest Mangwon alley building at night, empty of people.
Input image 1 is an approved EXTERIOR continuity and rendering reference: match its crisp drawn ink, modest older architecture, warm-lit upstairs window, cream curtains, dark metal sliding window frame, small plant at the sill, and navy night outside. Do not reproduce an exterior view or a restaurant interior.

Recipe: establish, detailed room reference. Camera just inside the doorway at 1.5 m height, looking slightly downward diagonally across the very small room, restrained wide angle without fisheye; one coherent horizon and floor plane. The desk, screens, microphone, ring light, docked drone, shelf photo and window must all be clearly readable, with no blocking overlap that hides a required prop. A room only about 2.6 m wide and 3 m deep with a low ordinary ceiling; human-scale desk about 74 cm high, ordinary chair, monitors about 24 inches. Show the close walls and a narrow usable floor aisle so it feels cramped and lived-in.

Composition and layout: a compact wood-laminate desk spans the far wall toward picture-left, two monitor screens beside each other, seen from the front with mild consistent perspective. An empty dark desk chair is tucked near the desk without obscuring either screen. EXACTLY TWO monitors; the whole active screen area of EACH is perfectly uniform flat pure chroma green #00FF00 (RGB 0,255,0), crisp inside dark bezels: absolutely no picture, lettering, UI, gradient, highlight or reflection on the active green surfaces. A black microphone with a simple pop filter hangs on a visibly hinged boom arm firmly clamped to the desk edge. One ring light on a slim supported stand sits beside the desk, its entire circular ring visible, white and dim enough to preserve the warm room lighting. At the other end of the desk, one small WHITE camera quadcopter with a black camera lens and four compact rotor guards rests physically on its charging dock, with a connected charging cable; it is docked, not hovering. Add a plain unlabelled cup ramen, keyboard and mouse, and a few practical connected cables.
A shallow shelf above the desk holds a SMALL framed family snapshot of two adult parents and their young daughter together: tiny generic coloured silhouettes with faces too small to distinguish, no specific likeness, no lettering, no close-up, and no separate reference needed. The frame is a minor shelf detail. Two modest abstract geometric/sky posters on the walls, strictly images only, with NO writing, logos, human portraits or numbers. A narrow bed edge may be cropped at picture-right to make the limited floor space clear.
The reference exterior's dark-framed two-panel upstairs sliding window is on the right side of the far wall, cream curtains drawn partly aside; outside is dark navy night with a close neighbouring wall and a few quiet alley details. Keep the little plant at the sill and a visible simple shaded warm lamp beside the window, matching the warm lamp seen from outside.

Lighting/mood: the visible shaded lamp at the window is the named dominant key, warm orange #F0B064 over muted grey-blue walls and navy #1B2440 night shadows. Soft light wash ONLY from practical lights, hard opaque cel shadow shapes, restrained white ring light fill. The green monitor surfaces remain completely flat and exact green. Quiet late-night working room after the restaurant has closed. Full establishing-detail density, legible room layout, clean hand-drawn furniture and supported functional equipment, modest surface wear rather than noisy texture. No general haze, no photographic or glossy CG rendering.
There are NO people in the room, no human reflections, and no animals. The only tiny generic humans are within the small framed family photo. Do not add other screens. Preserve 1536 x 1024 native output, do not upscale.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
attempts.reason: Selected after the five-attempt cap: strongest composition and clear docked four-rotor drone; smaller green-channel deviation than the final targeted edit. Original was provisionally rejected, then promoted; its duplicate in _rejects was removed.
